Debug & diagnostics

Manual actions

Manual lock/unlock overrides the automatic gantry policy while stopped (SAFE IDLE / BOOT); it clears when a run or rotate starts, and the lock is always released while the rotor turns. Lock travel drives the pin to an explicit position (0 = retracted, 100 = fully in) for tuning the bucket-sweep hold — find the depth that just clears the buckets, then set LOCK_PULSE_SWEEP_US to match.
